items: Magnesium hydroxide ('milk of magnesia') neutralises excess stomach acid and is a mild laxative; its low solubility makes it safe. Calcium carbonate is also used in indigestion tablets as an antacid.
Calcium compounds (calcium carbonate, calcium citrate and others) are needed for strong bones and teeth and are widely used as dietary supplements to prevent osteoporosis.
Magnesium compounds (magnesium sulphate, magnesium citrate and others) are important for muscle and nerve function and treat magnesium deficiency; Epsom salts are used as a laxative and in baths.
Barium sulphate is used in 'barium meals' for X-ray imaging of the digestive system: it is opaque to X-rays and safe because it is so insoluble that it passes through the body without being absorbed.
